frigate.notes: Aqara G400 supports RTSP and ONVIF for Home Assistant/Frigate. Enable RTSP in the Aqara Home app (camera > Settings > Advanced); the app generates a unique RTSP URL with per-camera credentials. Path shown is the typical Aqara format; use the exact URL provided by the app, or discover the stream via go2rtc ONVIF.
